ambiguities.what: r1 fixed bootstrap seed 20260924 without saying that its dev intervals were produced by j8_frontier, which always uses hj1_gate.SEED = 20260915. r2 §5.2 (F2) states it: dev values are at 20260915 unless marked.
ambiguities.script_behaviour: Test verdicts use 20260924. dev_reference blocks carry the 20260915 seed they were computed under; the regression test reproduces P1 at 20260915.

ambiguities.what: r1 quoted P3 and P4 intervals obtained by negating the stored contrast, and for P4 without saying so. Under the percentile convention (lo = means[250], hi = means[9750]) negation is not exactly the direct interval: one end moves by one order statistic (≈0.01 pp). r2 (F4) quotes both in their stored orientation and registers direct computation in the registered orientation.
ambiguities.script_behaviour: Every contrast is computed directly in the registered orientation (left − right). The P3 / P4 dev_reference blocks still hold the negated 114-pair values, labelled so.

ambiguities.what: r1 §5.3 applied Holm 'across the five predictions on goal_pass', but P2 is a cost predicate, so P1-P5 contain four goal_pass predictions.
ambiguities.script_behaviour: Resolved by A1 r2 §5.3: family = the goal_pass predictions whose support needs a rejection (P1, P3, P4, P6 → m = 4; A1 r3 registers no P7 component, B2 being unresolved). P2 (cost) and P5 (support by non-rejection) are outside it.

ambiguities.what: r1's decision rules were CI conditions while Holm needs p-values; r1 did not say how the two combine, nor that for P5 a Holm adjustment makes 'supported' EASIER (its support event is a non-rejection). r2 §5.3 (F3) registers both, as below.
ambiguities.script_behaviour: p = two-sided-equivalent percentile-bootstrap p for the rule's direction at its threshold (2 x tail share of the scenario-clustered bootstrap means). An exclusion event counts only if the CI excludes the threshold AND the Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05. Unadjusted and adjusted verdicts are both reported.

ambiguities.what: r1 required 336 non-crashed pairs per arm but did not say how a crash left in the tree is scored; the dev basis used j8's all-episodes view (crash = 0), with zero crashes, so the choice never mattered on dev. r2 §5.1 (F6): a residual crash removes the pair from every contrast and leaves the arm incomplete.
ambiguities.script_behaviour: A crashed episode is not an outcome: it is dropped from every pair and counted, and an arm with any crash or missing episode is incomplete, which refuses every prediction that uses it.

crash_convention: error_type == 'crash' is not an outcome (dropped, counted, arm incomplete); limit / timeout / parse_error / api_error are scored outcomes.

notes: Paired statistics pair on the (task_id, seed) keys both arms score, and a divergent key is a crash, which a1_arm_episodes already drops from its replay arm; so removing it from the other arm changes no paired statistic, only the counts of unpaired keys (n_left_only / n_right_only) and completeness.

Amendment 5 §B.1's 'after at least one crash-only resumption' cannot be read from an arm's files: the refill deletes a crashed episode's directory whole (scripts/setup/campaign_summarize.py purge_crashed) and re-runs it, so a divergent key is read as a crash whose last attempt holds the divergence error; the wrapper's tally lines record the resumption.
P2 and Amendment 4's P2 clauses are read from the cost report's per-episode rows without the removed keys; B3's cost plug-in likewise for a replay arm with divergent keys.

definitions.fenced_code: an opening ``` line (any info string), text, a closing ``` (j17_channel_fixes.py:95-98)
definitions.copy_rate_show: b2_decomposition.copy_rate (:560-603): shown actions the executor reproduces next
definitions.copy_rate_advice: interventions whose next executor action reproduces the advice, or a ```python block inside it (j17_channel_fixes.py:325-336)
definitions.copy_rate_takeover: not applicable: the planner's action is executed, nothing is shown or advised

verdict_sentences.P1: P1 (advise_k1_fullctx − prefix_m11, goal_pass): supported, -11.98 pp, scenario [-17.04, -6.92], Holm-adjusted p 0.0000; described only as correction-prompt advice at every step against the m = 11 prefix, never as advice at matched budget or as ruling out a budget effect (Amendment 1 §E, A1:829-833); P1 supported; survives Benjamini-Yekutieli across 17 contrasts (adjusted p = 0.0000). (h* BY family, Amendment 1 §F).
verdict_sentences.P2: P2 (advise_k1_fullctx vs prefix_m11, cost): supported, ratio 4.1646; Amendment 4: calls clause under both conventions True, tokens clause True.
verdict_sentences.P3: P3 (prefix_m11 − planner_alone_cap81, goal_pass): not_supported, -3.97 pp, scenario [-8.68, +0.96], Holm-adjusted p 0.2004; non-inferiority to the medium-effort planner in this harness, never to the planner at its best effort (Amendment 2, A1:914-918); dev, exploratory: the high-effort planner alone scores +11.97 pp goal_pass above the medium one on 114 keys [+6.14, +18.43], and against it prefix_m11 is not non-inferior (ceiling − arm +7.22 [+3.21, +11.47]; CEILHI-01, CEILHI-03); handoff-only (h*, registered, Amendment 3) B1a: fails, -7.33 pp over 182 handoff pairs, scenario [-15.57, +1.81] (Amendment 1 §B1, A1:735; never changes P3's verdict); flag companion B1a: fails, -13.34 pp over 164 handoff pairs, scenario [-19.37, -7.18] (Amendment 1 §B1, A1:735; never changes P3's verdict).
verdict_sentences.P4: P4 (prefix_zs_m11 − prefix_zs_m9, goal_pass): directionally_consistent, +2.07 pp, scenario [-0.23, +4.52], Holm-adjusted p 0.1648.
verdict_sentences.P5: P5 (advise_k1_fullctx − sft_plan, goal_pass): supported, +4.47 pp, scenario [-1.19, +10.07].
verdict_sentences.P6: P6 (takeover_k10 − advise_k10_fullctx, goal_pass): supported, +5.83 pp, scenario [+1.61, +10.31], Holm-adjusted p 0.0162; reported as "actions beat the registered advice prompt" [docs/prereg_j10_amendment_20260924.md:441-443], never as a channel effect without that qualification; E5 (takeover − neutral-prompt advice, exploratory): +0.44 pp [-3.03, +3.87]; CF1: supported; CF1 is supported, so P6 is reported only as "actions beat correction-prompt advice", never as a channel effect (Amendment 1 §C); P6 supported; does NOT survive Benjamini-Yekutieli across 17 contrasts (adjusted p = 0.0526). (h* BY family, Amendment 1 §F).
verdict_sentences.CF1: CF1 (advise_k10_neutral − advise_k10_fullctx, goal_pass): supported, +5.40 pp, scenario [+1.43, +9.37], Holm-adjusted p 0.0086; CF1 supported; does NOT survive Benjamini-Yekutieli across 17 contrasts (adjusted p = 0.0629). (h* BY family, Amendment 1 §F).

j9_claim_f1.statement: J9's Claim F1 (selective escalation) is reported as a dev-only negative: neither the linear verifier head nor the sequential router discriminates outcome-critical intervention points (scored AUROC 0.3867-0.5082), and the executor self-gate's p_ask never exceeds 0.0347 against thresholds of 0.3, 0.5 and 0.7.

provenance_statement.statement: Hosted episodes requested gpt-5.6-luna (3696), through codex CLI codex-cli 0.153.4 (3696) (pinned: gpt-5.6-luna at 0.153.4). The model that actually served a call is not observable: neither the codex exec --json stream nor the session transcript carries a server-reported model id, so the no-substitution rule is enforced on the request side only.

a1_tgc_secondary.rule: goal_pass remains the only metric in any rule; TGC is printed beside it as tgc_secondary on the S, E and pairwise rows, scenario and task clusterings, with no p-value, no Holm and no verdict
a1_tgc_secondary.handoff_depth: S6's TGC reads the flag-based handoff-only estimand, as its goal_pass (no h* companion)

a1_cost_contrasts.reading: information only: a mean paired difference and its intervals; no p-value, no Holm, no verdict
a1_cost_contrasts.estimand: mean over the (task_id, seed) keys both arms hold of (left − right) per episode
a1_cost_contrasts.pairs: pairwise_contrasts' pair list and orientation (A1 §7 item 2, a1_r2_pairwise); none defined here
a1_cost_contrasts.keys: Amendment 5 §B: the contrast's divergent keys leave both arms (a1_am5_exclusion), as in the quality contrasts; n_pairs per axis
a1_cost_contrasts.episodes: calls over A1's scored episodes (crashes excluded); tokens and USD over the cost report's rows

calls_attributed.definition: result.json n_planner_calls: the count as published (a replayed plan is one call)

calls_live.definition: calls_attributed minus usage.n_calls of the episode's own planner events with usage.provider == 'cache', events after the last run_start

tokens_as_published.definition: the cost report's per-episode noncached_tokens_per_episode (j12_cost_axes; a replayed plan at 0 tokens)

tokens_attributed.definition: tokens_as_published plus each replayed plan's source plan-event tokens (j12_cost_axes.episode_cached_plan_attribution, per episode exactly as a1_am4_arm)

usd_as_published.definition: the cost report's per-episode usd_per_episode (a replayed plan at $0)

usd_attributed.definition: usd_as_published plus each replayed plan priced from its source plan event (j12_cost_axes.episode_cached_plan_attribution, per episode exactly as a1_am4_arm)

bootstrap.helper: a1_contrast -> a1_interval -> cluster_bootstrap_means (the quality contrasts' path)
